description: Sideload (deploy) a Roku application to the device. Packages all files in the project directory and uploads them. A dev channel must not already be running, or it will be replaced.

files.description: Glob patterns for files to include. Defaults to all files in rootDir (**/*).

host.description: IP address or hostname of the Roku device

password.description: Developer password for the Roku device

rootDir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory containing the manifest file

name: roku_deploy
